DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ブーツの履き心地はいかがですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右は合いますが、左の甲が強く押されます。両方同じサイズです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左右の違いと左甲の圧迫を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The right one fits, but the left one presses hard on the top of my foot. They are both the same size.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the two sides and the pressure on the top of your left foot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 立った時と座った時で違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does it feel different when you stand and when you sit?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 立つと左だけ痛いです。右はそのままで、左の締め方を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 立位での痛みと左だけの調整を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only my left foot hurts when I stand. Could you leave the right one as it is and check how the left one is fastened?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the pain when standing and ask for adjustment of the left boot only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 左を緩めて、足の収まりを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll loosen the left one and check how your foot sits in it.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で無理にバックルを引っ張って壊したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: バックルを無理に操作せず係の調整を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I don't want to break the buckle by pulling on it too hard myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to adjust it instead of forcing the buckle yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少し緩めました。今、どう感じますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've loosened it a little. How does it feel now?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 痛みは減りましたが、かかとが浮く感じがあります。緩めるだけでよいとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 調整後の痛み減少とかかとの浮きを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The pain has eased, but it feels as though my heel lifts. I can't say that simply loosening it solves the problem.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the reduced pain and the heel lifting after adjustment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の形の左ブーツも試せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also try a differently shaped left boot.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 試したいです。左の痛みとかかとの浮きを両方確認し、合うものが決まってから借ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両方の問題を確認してから借用すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to try it. I'll check both the pain in my left foot and the heel lifting, and rent the boots after we find ones that fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check both problems before renting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 別のブーツをご用意します。右も含めた組合せを担当が確認してからお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll get another boot. The person in charge will check the combination, including the right boot, before handing them over.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お魚は何にお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What will you be using the fish for?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今夜の鍋です。薄く切ってあるこの魚を見ましたが、鍋に使う形か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍋予定と陳列魚の切り方を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: For a hot pot tonight. I saw this thinly sliced fish, but I don't know whether it is cut for hot pot.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your hot-pot plans and ask about the cut of the displayed fish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは刺身用に切っています。鍋用なら別の厚さを相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is sliced for sashimi. For hot pot, we can discuss a different thickness.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では鍋用をお願いします。二人分で、煮ても崩れにくい厚さにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数と崩れにくい厚さを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'd like fish for hot pot, please. It's for two people, and I'd like slices thick enough not to fall apart easily when simmered.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the number of people and request a thickness that resists falling apart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 骨の扱いもご相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you also like advice about the bones?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。骨が全部なくなるとは思っていませんが、大きい骨をどう避けるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 骨除去の限界を踏まえ扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I don't expect every bone to be removed, but I'd like to know how to avoid the large bones.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about handling the bones while acknowledging that they cannot all necessarily be removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 加工担当へ切り方と骨の説明を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the preparation staff to explain the cut and the bones.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。切る前に、選んだ魚と二人分の量も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 加工前に魚の種類と量を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Before cutting it, please also check which fish I've chosen and the quantity for two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the fish and quantity before preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が来ました。鍋用、二人分でよろしいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member is here. For hot pot, for two people, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。厚さと骨の説明を聞いたら購入を決めます。先に刺身の皿を会計しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に購入決定し刺身の会計を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll decide whether to buy it after hearing about the thickness and bones. Please don't ring up the plate of sashimi first.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will decide after the explanation and ask them not to charge for the sashimi. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 刺身の皿は戻します。鍋用の候補を加工担当とご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll put the sashimi back. Please check the hot-pot options with the preparation staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おそばのご注文でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to order soba?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小麦を避ける必要があります。そばという名前でも、小麦が入っていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: そばの小麦配合を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to avoid wheat. Can something called soba still contain wheat?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether soba contains wheat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 原材料を厨房へ確認します。小麦アレルギーのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the ingredients with the kitchen. Is this about a wheat allergy?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、医師から避けるよう言われています。麺だけでなく、つゆについても聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: アレルギーとつゆも確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, my doctor has told me to avoid it. I'd like to ask about the dipping broth as well as the noodles.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the allergy and ask to check the broth too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理で共用する道具についても確認が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We also need to check whether cooking utensils are shared.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。原材料に小麦がないだけで、私に安全と判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原材料だけで安全と断定しないよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Please don't conclude that it is safe for me just because wheat isn't listed in the ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them not to determine safety from the ingredients alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認したところ、この麺とつゆには小麦が含まれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked with the person in charge, and these noodles and this broth contain wheat.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、このそばは注文しません。別の品なら大丈夫とは、メニューだけで決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小麦ありの回答を受けそばを断る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't order this soba. I won't decide that another dish is all right just by looking at the menu.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline the soba after learning that it contains wheat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる別の料理もありますが、お時間がかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are other dishes we can check, but it will take some time.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は食事を見送ります。確認していただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食事を見送り未注文を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll skip eating here today. Thank you for checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decline the meal and confirm that no order has been placed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。料理の注文は入れていません。必要な条件が確認できる時に改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We haven't placed a food order. Please ask us again when we can confirm the conditions you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗船券の確認をします。

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この券を持っています。自転車も一台あるのですが、この券だけで載せられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗客券で自転車も載せられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have this ticket. I also have one bicycle. Can I take it aboard with just this ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a passenger ticket also covers taking a bicycle aboard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: これは乗客一名の券です。自転車の持込み条件は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This ticket is for one passenger. We'll check the conditions for bringing a bicycle separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。自転車に荷物も付けていますが、勝手に乗船口へ進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自転車の手続き前に乗船口へ進まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I have luggage attached to the bicycle too, but I won't go ahead to the boarding entrance without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not proceed to the boarding entrance before the bicycle arrangements are checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、そのままの形です。外せる荷物はありますが、自転車を袋に入れる準備はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 非折畳みと荷物の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, it's in its normal shape. Some luggage can be removed, but I'm not prepared to put the bicycle in a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the bicycle does not fold and describe the luggage situation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が積込み方法と空きを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will check the loading method and available space.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。追加料金と預ける場所も分かってから、手続きしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料金と積込場所の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'd like to complete the arrangements after I also know the extra charge and where to leave it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of the charge and loading location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認中は、一般の通路を空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the public passage clear while you wait for us to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自転車を横へ寄せ、持込みができるかの回答を待ちます。人の券があるだけで載せられるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け自転車の可否確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll move my bicycle to the side and wait to hear whether I can bring it aboard. I won't assume that a passenger ticket alone allows it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the passage clear and wait for confirmation about the bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼びました。この位置でお待ちください。持込み条件を確認してから案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've called the person in charge. Please wait here. We'll explain what to do after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵の受取に来られたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect some keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、通知をもらいました。黒いケース付きの鍵をなくしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知を示しなくした鍵の外観を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I received a notice. I lost keys with a black case.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the notice and describe the appearance of the lost keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の番号を確認します。ほかに特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the notice number. Are there any other identifying features?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ケースの内側に白い傷があります。鍵の本数は三本だったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内側の傷と記憶する本数を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's a white scratch inside the case. I think there were three keys.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the scratch inside and the number of keys you remember. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保管している鍵は二本です。本数について確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The keys we have in storage number two. Can you check the number?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一本は仕事場に置いたかもしれません。二本だから自分のものではないとも、すぐには言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本数差と置いた可能性を正直に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I may have left one at work. I can't immediately say these aren't mine just because there are two.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Honestly explain the difference in number and the possibility that you left one elsewhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認の後、特徴を担当と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking your identity, we'll compare the features with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。保管品の写真を先に見てから、特徴を後付けで合わせることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の記憶の特徴で照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I won't look at a photo of the stored item first and then change my description to match it.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the features you remember yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ通知番号と今の説明を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass the notice number and your explanation to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。持ち主の確認が済むまで、自分の鍵として持ち帰りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持主確認前に持ち帰らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't take them home as my keys until ownership has been confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not take the keys before ownership is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号と特徴を確認する相談として受け付けました。こちらで担当をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've registered your request to check the number and features. Please wait here for the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like your boxed meal heated?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、アイスも買うので、温かいものと分けて入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 弁当温めとアイスの袋分けを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I'm buying ice cream too, so please pack it separately from the hot food.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to heat the meal and bag the ice cream separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have your own bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つ持っています。保冷袋はアイス用で、もう一つは弁当用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの持参袋の用途を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have two. The insulated bag is for the ice cream, and the other one is for the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the uses of your two bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 飲み物はどちらへ入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which bag should I put the drink in?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 冷たいお茶は保冷袋へお願いします。弁当と一緒に温める商品ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冷茶の袋と加熱対象外を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please put the cold tea in the insulated bag. It isn't something to heat with the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the bag for the cold tea and that it should not be heated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お弁当を温めている間に、冷たいものをこちらへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll put the cold items in here while the meal is heating.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。弁当のふたが傾かないよう、温かい方の袋は底を広げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 弁当を水平に入れる準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'll open out the bottom of the bag for the hot food so the meal's lid won't tilt.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you are preparing to keep the meal level in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 温めが終わりました。こちらの袋でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The heating is finished. Is this the right bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その袋へ入れてください。アイスの袋と持ち手も分けて持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を照合して別々に受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please put it in that bag. I'll keep its handles separate from the ice-cream bag's handles when carrying them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the bag and receive the bags separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お弁当は右の袋、アイスとお茶は保冷袋です。分けてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The meal is in the bag on the right, and the ice cream and tea are in the insulated bag. I'll hand them over separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与の資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your salary documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、二枚あります。途中で会社を変えたので、別の会社から一枚ずつ届きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転職年の別会社二枚の給与資料を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I have two. I changed companies during the year, so each company sent me one.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Present two salary documents from different companies in the year you changed jobs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ会社の訂正版ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So one isn't a corrected version from the same company?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。前の会社と今の会社です。新しい方だけ残して、古い方を捨ててよいとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訂正版でなく二社分で旧紙を捨てないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. One is from my previous company and one from my current company. I don't assume I can keep just the newer one and throw the old one away.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that they are from two companies rather than a correction and that you will keep the old document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象の年と会社名を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the year and company names.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二枚とも今年の分です。ただ、支給の期間が違うので、同じ期間の二重記録かも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同年だが支給期間の重複確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both are for this year. But the payment periods differ, so I'd also like to check whether the same period has been recorded twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check for overlapping payment periods in the same year. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期間が分かる給与明細もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have payslips showing the periods?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。入社日と退職日のメモも持ってきました。金額を自分でまとめて一枚に書き換えてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明細在籍日を示し自己合算で原資料を変えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I've also brought notes of my starting and leaving dates. I haven't added the amounts myself and rewritten them on a single sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the payslips and employment dates and explain that you have not altered the originals by combining totals yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原資料を分けて担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the original documents separately to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二社の原資料と期間を示し、この年の申告でどう扱うか説明を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二社の原資料と期間で申告の扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll show the originals from both companies and their periods, and hear how to handle them for this year's filing.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about filing using the originals and periods from both companies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二社分の相談としてご案内します。年、会社名、対象期間を分けて担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-JOETSU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll direct you to a consultation about the two companies. Please explain the year, company names and periods separately to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方とはぐれましたか。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you become separated from the person you're with?

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。電話はつながりますが、花火の音で何を言っているか聞こえません。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通話が騒音で聞き取れないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. We can connect by phone, but I can't hear what they're saying over the fireworks.
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the noise prevents you from understanding the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 文字のメッセージは送れますか。

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送れます。私は入口の案内板にいますが、相手は屋台の近くとしか言っていません。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文字送信可能と双方の現在地を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'm at the information board by the entrance, but they've only said they're near the food stalls.
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can text and describe both current locations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩きながら探すと、互いにすれ違うかもしれません。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you both walk around searching, you might pass each other.

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私はこちらに残ります。案内板の文字と近くの番号を、メッセージで送ります。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分は固定場所に残り目印を送ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll stay here. I'll text them the words on the information board and the nearby number.
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will stay in one place and send identifying landmarks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内板には入口Bと書かれています。

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口Bの案内板で待つ、と送ります。相手にも今の場所を文字で返してもらいます。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口表示で待ち相手の位置も文字で求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll text that I'm waiting at the Entrance B information board. I'll ask them to text their current location back too.
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the entrance sign to describe where you will wait and request their location by text too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流まで、通路の中央は空けてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the middle of the passage clear until you meet up.

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。案内板の横に寄ります。返事がない間は別の入口へ勝手に移動しません。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路を空け連絡なしに場所を変えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll stand beside the board. I won't move to another entrance on my own while waiting for a reply.
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the passage clear and explain that you will not change location without communicating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そこなら通路を空けられます。移動が必要になった場合は、先に相手へ文字で知らせてください。
DLG-SC-NIG-NAGAOKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: You can keep the passage clear there. If you need to move, text the other person before doing so.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 寸法の確認は済みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished checking the dimensions?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。図面はミリですが、測定器の画面がいつもと違う単位になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図面と測定器の単位の違いを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. The drawing is in millimeters, but the measuring instrument's screen is showing a different unit from usual.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the difference between the drawing's units and the measuring instrument's units. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 加工は始めていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。数値だけ合わせると、違う長さで加工してしまうと思い、止めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未加工で誤加工防止のため停止中と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I stopped because matching just the numbers could mean machining it to the wrong length.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that machining has not started and that you have stopped to prevent an error. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 単位表示を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the unit indicator together.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに小さく表示があります。切替方法が分からないので、教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単位表示を示し設定方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's a small indicator here. I don't know how to switch it. Could you show me?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the unit indicator and ask how to change the setting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が設定します。そのあと基準の部品を測って確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will set it. After that, measure the reference part to check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。切り替えただけで正しいとせず、基準部品の値も図面と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 基準部品の測定で設定を確認すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't assume it is correct just because the unit was changed. I'll compare the reference part's measurement with the drawing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will verify the setting by measuring the reference part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認結果はどこへ記録しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Where will you record the check results?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 点検欄に単位と測定結果を書きます。確認が終わったら、加工を始めてよいか報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単位と測定結果を記録し開始前に報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write the units and measurement results in the inspection field. Once I've finished checking, I'll report and ask whether I may start machining.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will record the units and results and report before starting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で進めてください。まず測定器の設定と基準部品をこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that order. First, we'll check the instrument settings and reference part here.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お惣菜についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the prepared food?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この値引き品を明日の昼に食べたいです。期限の小さい文字が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日の喫食予定と期限の読取を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to eat this discounted item at lunchtime tomorrow. I can't read the small print showing the use-by limit.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain when you plan to eat it and ask for help reading the limit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示では今日中です。今夜は食べない予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The label says to eat it today. Are you not planning to eat it tonight?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。明日の弁当に入れるつもりでした。安いからといって明日まで大丈夫とは考えない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日中の期限と予定が合わないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I was going to put it in tomorrow's boxed lunch. I shouldn't assume it will last until tomorrow just because it's cheap, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the limit of today does not fit your plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示に合う商品を選ぶ方がよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be better to choose a product whose label fits your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、この品は戻します。明日食べる予定に合う別の食品を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 値引き品を戻し別食品を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll put this one back. I'd like to find another food that suits my plan to eat it tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will return the discounted item and look for another food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち帰りにどのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: How long will it take you to get it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一時間ほどです。保冷袋は持っていますが、それで期限が延びるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持帰り時間と保冷でも期限は延びないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: About an hour. I have an insulated bag, but I don't think that extends the use-by limit.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the journey home and that an insulated bag does not extend the limit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の棚の表示を一緒に見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can look at the labels on another shelf together.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。食べる日と保存方法の両方を確認してから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 喫食日と保存方法を照合して選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll check both the day I'll eat it and the storage instructions before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose after checking the eating date and storage instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの棚へどうぞ。期限と保存表示を読んで、ご予定に合うものをお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NIG-NAGAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come to this shelf. Read the use-by and storage labels and choose something that fits your plans.
